parakeet: So let's get this straight. If Jesus didn't even call himself good, what does that say about the millions of people walking around calling themselves good Christians? According to the Bible, they don't exist. Not because people can't do good things, but because the theology requires you to believe you're broken, sinful, and incapable of true goodness on your own.
